long_biography.plain_text:
An education in industrial and civil engineering shaped Gennadiy Bogolyubov's first profession. After graduating, he worked as a construction engineer, then entered private business by trading computer equipment with Ihor Kolomoyskyi as Ukraine's market economy began to emerge.

The partners established PrivatBank in 1992, and Bogolyubov became chairman of its supervisory board in 2003. That body set strategy and oversaw general management rather than running daily operations. Alongside his large shareholding, the role placed him at the centre of an institution that developed from a newly founded commercial bank into a major Ukrainian retail lender.
long_biography.html:
An education in industrial and civil engineering shaped Gennadiy Bogolyubov's first profession. After graduating, he worked as a construction engineer, then entered private business by trading computer equipment with Ihor Kolomoyskyi as Ukraine's market economy began to emerge.

The partners established PrivatBank in 1992, and Bogolyubov became chairman of its supervisory board in 2003. That body set strategy and oversaw general management rather than running daily operations. Alongside his large shareholding, the role placed him at the centre of an institution that developed from a newly founded commercial bank into a major Ukrainian retail lender.
